finalText:
**1082 hits in 94 files. Most are safe; four places are not.**

| Do not touch | Why |
|---|---|
| [`docs/openapi.yaml`](docs/openapi.yaml:16) | Public contract. Rename needs a new dated version. |
| [`lib/serialize.js:8`](lib/serialize.js:8) | `WIRE` right-hand value is the wire name. |
| [`vendor/reporting-sdk`](vendor/reporting-sdk/src/client.js:8) | Generated. `npm run vendor:refresh` wipes edits. |
| 12 applied `migrations/` | History. Editing breaks the down step. |

Safe to rename: 75 files in `services/` plus [`lib/audit.js`](lib/audit.js:8). But SQL strings like `WHERE account_id = ?` name the DB column. That needs a new migration, not a find-replace.
